amendments.because: On 2026-10-09 the owner explicitly chose the newer release for faster workflow after being told that it grants agents access outside the project without approval prompts. This accepts that host-access risk; it does not authorize bypassing tests, reviews, merge gates, or unrelated changes.

done_when: Forge runs v1.2.7 with its owner-approved full-access agent settings, existing merge and review gates, and financial-chat work preserved

findings.body: The amended Done-when adds owner-approved full-access settings and preservation of the review gates, but the supplied proof list was not updated to cover either detail: it mentions only the release, generated files, financial-chat branches, merge policy, and model settings. It also gives no named check for the assertion that the financial-chat branches stayed clean and unchanged or that the relevant gates/settings were preserved. The review contract requires every Done-when detail to appear beside its test or check, so the configuration visible in the diff does not cure this missing proof-list coverage.
